result_import.missing_or_error: Unknown/null displays as unavailable; malformed import reports one error, prior valid state retained; unsupported scenario never enabled as result

projection.full_results: gzip финалистов/основных выводов; остальные с sourcefullresultSHA256 и повторяемым replay

projection.financial_nulls: operating_result and full funding null remain unknown; known_operating_subtotal is a separately labelled known subtotal, never full profit.
projection.pagination: 16rows per page; full arrays retained; native paging/base+cautious checked on actual accepted canonical results.
